adjudication.rationale: In `addGuestsHandler` the code reads a snapshot of `booking.attendees` via `prisma.booking.findFirst(... include: { attendees: true })`, computes `uniqueGuests` by filtering against that snapshot, then after multiple `await`s performs `prisma.booking.update(... attendees: { createMany: { data: guestsFullDetails }})`. With concurrent requests adding the same email(s) to the same booking, both can pass the `uniqueGuests` filter (based on stale `booking.attendees`) and then both attempt `createMany`, which can produce duplicate attendee rows or trigger a unique constraint error (if such a constraint exists) that isn’t handled (no transaction / no P2002 handling).
